description: RadioGroup renders a labeled fieldset containing native radio inputs. It supports controlled and uncontrolled selection, group layout, visual options, validation feedback, and native radio input properties.

elements.name: name
elements.description: The shared native name for all radio inputs in the group. It is required.

elements.name: label
elements.description: The group legend displayed above the radio options. It is required.

elements.name: elements
elements.description: The available options. Each option requires a string value and can provide a React label, native input properties, and an individual disabled state.

elements.name: value
elements.description: Controls the selected option value. Use null when no option is selected. Omit it to use the uncontrolled mode.

elements.name: defaultValue
elements.description: Sets the initially selected option value in uncontrolled mode.

elements.name: onChange
elements.description: Receives the native change event when an option changes.

elements.name: onValue
elements.description: Receives the selected option value directly. It receives null when deselect clears the selection.

elements.name: variant
elements.description: Sets the option style to primary, secondary (default), or transparent.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Sets the shared component size to sm, md, or lg.

elements.name: columns
elements.description: Sets the number of grid columns used to arrange the options. Defaults to 1.

elements.name: required
elements.description: Marks every native radio input as required so the browser requires a selection.

elements.name: disabled
elements.description: Disables the entire group. Individual options can also be disabled through their element definition.

elements.name: deselect
elements.description: Allows the selected option to be cleared by clicking it again.

elements.name: tooltip
elements.description: Displays tooltip content for an individual option on hover. Set it in the corresponding element definition.

elements.name: isIcon
elements.description: Shows the custom radio indicator when true. Defaults to true.

elements.name: ripple
elements.description: Enables or disables ripple feedback on the options. It is enabled by default except for the transparent variant.

elements.name: error
elements.description: Displays an error message below the group, sets aria-invalid, and associates the message through aria-describedby.

elements.name: errorProps
elements.description: Passes native paragraph properties to the error message element.

elements.name: containerProps
elements.description: Passes native fieldset properties to the group container.

elements.name: Native radio properties
elements.description: Native input properties such as required, disabled, autoFocus, and event handlers are forwarded to the radio inputs or group.

accessibility.general: The component uses a native fieldset, legend, and radio inputs, preserving native keyboard navigation, group semantics, form behavior, and required validation. Error messages are announced politely and linked to the group.
elements: Provide a meaningful label so the group has an accessible legend.
Use a unique name for each independent radio group so browsers and assistive technologies treat the options as one choice set.
Keep meaningful text in each option's label so every native radio has an accessible name.
Error content is associated with the group through aria-describedby and announced with aria-live="polite".
Do not rely on color, ripple, tooltips, or the custom indicator alone to communicate the selected state; the native radio input remains the semantic source.
